definitions.name: business_authenticated
definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.business_authenticated()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$select private.live_auth_session() is not null$function$

definitions.name: delete_my_account
definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_my_account()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then return; end if;
    delete from auth.users where id = auth.uid();
    end $function$

definitions.name: can
definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can(perm text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select private.secure_scope_active('admin') and private.can_raw(perm)
$function$
